summary: Fixed harness cost display in public/graph.html — three edits: (1) hero value now shows cronTotal only, not cronTotal+overheadTok; (2) machine-injected overhead section shows harness_fraction % instead of a fabricated Haiku-rate dollar cost, reordered sub-rows, updated note text; (3) footer totals drop the double-counted overhead addend line, grand total is now totalCost+cronCost only.

subject: Fix harness cost display — overhead is a decomposition of task-session billing, not an addend
description: The machine-injected session overhead is ALREADY inside the task-session billing total. Showing it as an addend in the footer double-counts it. Three fixes needed in public/graph.html: 1. Line ~5080: hero value should only show cron total (true extra cost), remove the +overheadTok: Change: `const overheadTok=...; const el=... el.textContent=fmtK(cronTotal+overheadTok);` To: `const el=... el.textContent=fmtK(cronTotal);` 2. Lines ~5142-5152: the "Machine-injected session overhead" section shows dollar cost at Haiku rate (ohCost) — replace this with a % framing. Instead of showing a cost figure: - Change the row to show `${fmtK(ohTok)} tokens (${oh.harness_fraction!=null?Math.round(oh.harness_fraction*100)+'%':'—'} of session input)` - Remove the `${fmtUSD(ohCost)}` - Change the note to: "These tokens are already counted in the task-session billing above — this is how much of your input spend went to Zonoid's own machinery." - Keep all the sub-rows (tool_result, automation_messages, system_reminder_est, etc.) as informational breakdown 3. Lines ~5173-5174: remove the "session overhead (Haiku rate)" addend line and update the grand total to be just task sessions + cron/gate: Remove: the `oh&&oh.overhead?...session overhead...` line Change Total est. to: `totalCost + cronCost` only
